author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then we would return, enhanced by reason of our experiences.
context_before: The mortal mind, unable to understand this statement, questioned him, asking him to tell them who he really was and he answered: “Even what I have told you from the beginning.” The beginning of what? The year 1 A.D.? No. Before that the world was, you and I were told that we would descend into and experience death.
context_after: Knowing me and my mortal beginning of only a few years, you may question my words, but I am not speaking about a physical being. The Lord Jesus Christ
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Light Of The World (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Hitler was used for a purpose.
context_before: ed for many years. He thought he had control forever, but he lost it, for God has planned everything as it has come out and as it will be consummated.
context_after: To us it was a horrible purpose, but – as we are told in Genesis: “You intended it for evil, but God meant it for good.” Joseph (the dreamer in you) was sold into slavery, for God knew he could be used for His purpose. The brothers intended evil against him, but God meant it for good and raised Joseph to the level of the Pharaoh, where he saved civilization from starvation.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Light Of The World (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And then I called you princes.
context_before: “Who are you?” they asked. “Even what I have told you from the beginning.” Yes, I am the same being who spoke to you when we all gathered together in eternity. Before we came down you and I were one. Calling you gods, Sons of the Most High, I told you that we were going to have the experience of dying and falling as one man.
context_after: And one day you will know yourself to be the prince of light, the prince of love, and the prince of power, for everything recorded in scripture will be experienced by you. That is your destiny.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Light Of The World (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Are you thinking of a physical savior?
context_before: Now I ask you: are you thinking of Jesus as a being of flesh and blood when you know that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of heaven?
context_after: Didn’t you receive the spirit by hearing the story and accepting it with faith, for your acceptance was the spirit. If after hearing this incredible story you believe it, go your way and it will unfold within you. But if you reject it, your rejection will simply delay its experience, for you are destined to know the truth which will set you free from this bondage to decay.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Light Of The World (1969-01-01).
